explication: FreeVideo is a local MiniMax H3 video-inference engine, exposed through a ComfyUI creative workspace and a Linux CLI, with a Windows launcher for setup. The main user flow is to configure an installation, submit a prompt and optional media references, encode conditioning, admit and run a hardware-aware sampling request, then decode and present the video. Separate branches cover model/environment deployment, ComfyUI setup and workflow UI, and resource planning and telemetry. Connections are limited to README statements and relationships visible in the supplied excerpts or SOURCE INDEX; unsampled internals are not asserted.
